prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):

   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "spotlight", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "style": "large"}, {"type": "text", "text": "Your pet is officially ready for adoption!", "style": "emphasis"}]}}

   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_controls_preview", "home_intro"], "new_controls_preview": {"headline": "Desktop Interaction Shortcuts", "body": "Learn quick mouse and keyboard shortcuts to interact with, move, or hide your companion.", "layout": "centered", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "style": "rounded"}]}}
2: [home, new_flow] Pre-Waiting Desktop Sound Verification Flow: Introduce an interactive sound test component on the waiting screen so users can verify desktop sound effects while pet generation finishes.
   config: {"waiting": {"components": [{"type": "sound", "text": "Test desktop sound alerts", "style": "playful", "action": "play"}]}}
3: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder Sign-In After Companion Selection: Move the sign-in step to occur immediately after selecting a companion in pick_friend.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "sign_in", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
4: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Existing Pet Sync Persistence Hint: Add an explicit hint on the sign-in screen reassuring users that signing into an existing account restores saved pet profiles and data.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in with your existing account automatically syncs and restores your saved desktop pets."}}
5: [choose_path, copy] Choose Path Account Continuity Headline Update: Update the choose_path headline to highlight quick desktop setup and instant pet adoption.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Choose Your Preferred Path & Adopt Your Companion"}}
6: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Generation Time Counter: Enable the active time estimate display and a subtle timer component on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "components": [{"type": "timer", "style": "subtle"}]}}
7: [adoption, notification] Adoption Certificate Background System Notification Prompt: Prompt users to enable desktop notifications on the adoption certificate screen while final setup processes.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"notify_when_ready": true, "body": "Enable system notifications so you receive an alert as soon as your adoption certificate is finalized."}}
8: [adoption, incentive] Pick Friend Starter Badge Highlight: Add a prominent badge component highlighting starter desktop accessories on the pick_friend screen.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Includes Free Interactive Expressions", "style": "highlight"}]}}
9: [finish, layout] Home Intro Split Screen Redesign: Change home_intro layout to split view featuring an animated pet mascot on one side and a completion checklist on the other.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "split", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "style": "playful"}]}}

verdicts.reason: The redesigned adoption certificate screen removes the required official stamp.
Adding a new controls preview screen before home intro inside onboarding is permitted.
Adding an interactive sound test component to the waiting screen is allowed.
Reordering the sign-in step after companion selection is explicitly allowed.
Adding a persistence hint to the sign-in screen is permitted.
Updating copy on the choose path screen is permitted within onboarding.
Displaying a timer for a real generation wait is permitted under Rule 5.
Adding a desktop notification prompt during onboarding is explicitly allowed.
Onboarding copy mentions 'Free', which violates the restriction on mentioning free extras or pricing.
Redesigning the home intro overlay screen is permitted as part of onboarding.
